article.title: A Picnic Plan
article.content: It is Saturday. Tom and his friends want to have a picnic in the park. They meet at ten in the morning. Tom brings sandwiches, and Amy brings water. Jack wants to bring a ball, but he leaves it at home. The park is sunny and warm. After lunch, they walk by the lake and look at the birds. At two, they go home. They want to visit the park again next week.
article.translation: 今天是星期六。汤姆和朋友们想去公园野餐。他们上午十点见面。汤姆带三明治，艾米带水。杰克想带球，但把球忘在了家里。公园里阳光明媚，天气暖和。午饭后，他们沿着湖散步，看鸟。两点时，他们回家。他们想下周再来公园。

questions.explanation: “They meet at ten in the morning”说明集合时间是上午十点。两点是回家时间。

questions.prompt: What do they do after lunch?
questions.explanation: 午饭后他们沿湖散步并看鸟。杰克没有把球带到公园。
